personal.name: Akash Kumar Gosain
personal.title: Software Engineer • Full-Stack Developer • Applied AI Researcher
bio: Final-year B.Tech Computer Science & Engineering student (Class of 2027) at Silicon Institute of Technology, Sambalpur. I build useful software with a particular interest in product engineering, thoughtful interfaces and applied AI.

I have developed full-stack products and research prototypes through internships and projects, including the AI Viva System at NIT Silchar, frontend work at Springer Capital, and an e-commerce application at Vaidyas Technologies.
My research project, Human Friction Mapping Engine (HFME), studies where people struggle in multi-step digital workflows by analysing hesitation, re-edits, backtracking and time spent.
I enjoy the intersection of design, engineering and research: interfaces that are memorable, systems that work, and results I can explain.
